children: authID entered into a Backstop Commitment Agreement with certain holders of its senior secured debentures to provide up to $500,000 in short-term financing support, depending on a potential strategic investor funding. The company may draw $300,000 at any time and an additional $200,000 after half of the strategic partner proceeds are used; $300,000 was funded on Sep 11, 2026. As consideration, authID issued 750,000 five-year warrants at a $0.57 exercise price, fixed the debenture conversion price at $0.38, and repriced existing warrants to $0.57, subject to Nasdaq’s 19.99% cap and stockholder approvals for director-held securities. Any funded amounts will be reflected in a pari passu Backstop Debenture, exchangeable into common stock at $0.38, with planned resale registration rights.
: Backstop commitment agreement with potential convertible debenture issuance
: Provide short-term liquidity ahead of potential strategic partner funding
